no_target_yet.statement:
In a fragment with $n$ centres and imbalance $d$, all eigenvalues are
\begin{equation}
 E_{n,d,k}(\Delta)=\frac{\sqrt{4+9\Delta^2}}2(2k-n)
                         +\frac\Delta2d,
 \qquad\text{with multiplicity }\binom nk,\quad 0\leq k\leq n.
\end{equation}
For $\Delta\ne0$, an imbalanced fragment has a zero mode precisely
when, for an allowed $s=2k-n\ne0$,
\begin{equation}
 d^2>9s^2,\qquad
 \Delta^2=\frac{4s^2}{d^2-9s^2},\qquad s\Delta d<0.
\end{equation}
At $L=48$, centres $1,7,13,19,25,31,37,43$ and
$\Delta=2/\sqrt7$ give 56 zero modes in an imbalanced fragment.

no_target_yet.statement:
Starting from one $X_{1,j}$ bubble in an even chain,
\begin{equation}
 e^{-itH_3}|X_{1,j}\rangle=
 \cos t\,|X_{1,j}\rangle-i\sin t\,|X_{2,j}\rangle,
 \qquad M_s(t)=(-1)^{j+1}(1+3\cos2t).
\end{equation}
For a product bubble Fock state with $n$ centres and initial
pseudospin signs $\eta_j\in\{1,-1\}$, the corresponding formulas are
$\bigotimes_j e^{-it\tau_j^x}|\eta_j\rangle$ and
$M_s(t)=-\sum_j(-1)^j(1+3\eta_j\cos2t)$.
